text_block_list.text:
The first hurdle on the road to the
Classic Triple
Crown is upon us—the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I falter here, my dream of claiming the
Classic
Triple Crown will vanish like
smoke in the wind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now, in that eventuality, I would of
course seek
another way. My ideals are
resilient enough to
survive defeat.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But that does not change my
desire—nay, my
need to be victorious.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
After all, how can an Emperor with no
crown win
the love of her people?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I believe that my dream is worthwhile,
but if I am
to realize it, I must speak with
authority.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That is why I must prove my supremacy,
both in
title and in deed. That is why I
must claim the
Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф speaks so fervently that
it sets my
skin tingling. But suddenly her
face falls.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Still, I have hardly earned the right to
make such
grand proclamations.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Not when I have been so blind to the
troubles of
my own student council.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It was disappointing, I admit, to find that
I have
been left out of the loop.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It is hard to see myself as reliable when
others
clearly do not.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
She's got this all wrong. Эйр Грув and
the rest
of the student council just didn't
want to worry
her before a big race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No, I understand. They were only trying
to be
considerate.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: But I would have preferred they hadn't.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I wish they didn't feel such an

obligation.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Surely an Emperor's people must be able
to rely
upon her for support at any time?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's hard to know what to say in response
to that.
Considering the dream she's
chasing, it only
makes sense for her to
strive for perfection...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Clearly, I have yet to reach those
heights... All
the more reason I must
forge on.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I must show Эйр Грув and everyone
else that
I'm strong enough to shoulder
their burdens.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And the Satsuki Sho will be the first step
on my
path to greatness.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
